source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 from Netcare Limited results for the six months ended 31 March 2026, key financial results table, unit R million stored in absolute rand. Revenue 13281 and normalised operating profit 1786 are printed; no cost of sales or gross profit line is printed so those are honest dashes. Operating Expenses 11495 is the complement of the printed operating profit within the same statement. Net Finance Costs 499 is the difference between the printed normalised operating profit 1786 and the printed normalised profit before taxation 1287. There were no exceptional items in the period so normalised profit after taxation 924 equals IFRS profit for the period, and 1287 less taxation 363 equals 924. The EPS cell is an honest dash: the issuer headlined adjusted headline earnings per share of 71.7 cents and printed no basic IFRS earnings per share.
